doc:
Native 60 fps across an ExHiROM seam

Frames 0–599, 600–1199, and 1200–1799 are three distinct ten-second excerpts from NASA SVS’s native-60p XRISM turntable master. The third cut begins exactly at logical stream offset $3F0000, crossing from ExHiROM region A into file $410000 / CPU bank $41. Start pauses/resumes, A resumes after seeking, L/R step one frame, and Left/Right seek one second or shuttle at 2×, 4×, then 8× when held. Browser keyboards and phone touch controllers use the matching on-screen SNES controls.

Source: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio item 20374, XRISM Beauty Shots, credited to NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center Conceptual Image Lab. No duplicated 30-fps frames, optical-flow interpolation, Duck and Cover footage, or animated turtle sequence is present.
